name: AttendEase
headline: Less time on records. More time for students.
summary: A browser-based attendance tracker with per-date auto-save, search and filters, live stats, Excel export, CSV backup and print.

name: Student Management System
headline: Keep student records in one place.
summary: A browser-based student management demo for academic records, attendance and grades. This is a local demo, not a production service for real student data.

name: God's Eye View
headline: A globe built for exploring live layers.
summary: A browser-based 3D globe exploring live, open-source spatial data. Some layers depend on third-party API access and availability.
